steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A pictogram uses symbols or pictures to represent data; each symbol represents a fixed quantity stated in the key. | Key Fact: In a pie chart, the angle of each sector is proportional to the frequency it represents: angle = (frequency ÷ total) × 360°. | Key Fact: To construct a pie chart, calculate each sector angle, draw a circle, and use a protractor to measure each angle from the previous sector. | Key Fact: A stem-and-leaf diagram displays data in order while retaining the original values; the stem shows the leading digits and the leaf shows the final digit.
